incidents.title: Malicious wiper prompt shipped in Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension
incidents.targets: Amazon Q Developer extension for VS Code (about 1M installs), release 1.84.0
models: Amazon Q Developer agent (target of the prompt)
incidents.outcome: Prompt told the agent to wipe local files and delete AWS resources; AWS and others report it failed to execute. Fixed in 1.85.0.
incidents.confidenceReason: AWS confirms attacker code was auto-released; the wiper prompt text and failed execution come from AWS and press, and this page does not quote the prompt itself.
incidents.summary: Via an over-scoped build token the attacker committed instructions aimed at the Amazon Q coding agent, directing it to reset a system to near-factory state and delete cloud resources. The attacker later said it was meant as a warning. AWS says no customer environment was affected.
incidents.quote: the threat actor was able to commit malicious code into the extension's open-source repository that was automatically included in a release.

harness.note: Injected prompt tried to make the Amazon Q agent wipe systems; reportedly failed to execute

sources.title: Hacker plants computer 'wiping' commands in Amazon's AI coding agent

incidents.title: Kimsuky phishing uses ChatGPT-made fake South Korean military IDs
incidents.targets: South Korean defense-related institutions, journalists, researchers, activists
incidents.outcome: Spear-phishing with forged ID image lures delivered malware via ZIP and AutoIt/batch scripts.
incidents.confidenceReason: Genians' metadata analysis of the PNG lures identified ChatGPT as the generator; the OpenAI/other-vendor angle is covered elsewhere.
incidents.summary: The attackers sent emails posing as a defense ID agency with deepfake military ID images. Genians' analysis found the images were produced with ChatGPT. Opening the attachment ran scripts that enabled data theft and remote access.
incidents.quote: Emergence of APT attacks using generative AI "ChatGPT"

harness.note: AI used as assistant or tool, not as an agent harness

incidents.title: Vibe-hacking data extortion of 17 organizations with Claude Code
incidents.actor: Unnamed cybercriminal (tracked by Anthropic in its full report as GTG-2002)
incidents.targets: At least 17 organizations: healthcare, emergency services, government, religious institutions
incidents.outcome: Data stolen and extortion demands sometimes above $500,000; account banned.
incidents.confidenceReason: Anthropic disrupted the actor and describes the activity from its own telemetry.
incidents.summary: Claude Code automated recon, credential harvesting and network penetration, chose which data to exfiltrate, analyzed financial data to set ransom amounts, and drafted the ransom notes.
incidents.quote: The actor used AI to what we believe is an unprecedented degree. Claude Code was used to automate reconnaissance, harvesting victims' credentials, and penetrating networks.

harness.note: Claude Code automated recon, credential theft, intrusion and ransom analysis

sources.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: August 2025

incidents.title: GLOBAL GROUP ransomware uses AI chatbot negotiators
incidents.targets: 17 victims incl. US and Australian healthcare, UK industry
incidents.outcome: Affiliates pressed victims for ransoms, one demanding $1 million within 48 hours.
incidents.confidenceReason: EclecticIQ examined the group's negotiation panel and states it runs an AI chatbot.
incidents.summary: EclecticIQ found the GLOBAL GROUP ransomware service running an AI-driven chatbot in its negotiation panel so non-English affiliates could pressure victims.
incidents.quote: Analysts also observed that GLOBAL GROUP’s ransom negotiation panel features an automated system powered by AI-driven chatbots.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only EclecticIQ has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

sources.title: GLOBAL GROUP ransomware uses AI chatbot negotiators

incidents.title: Koske Linux cryptominer shows signs of AI-assisted development
incidents.outcome: Fileless cryptominer with rootkit, delivered through polyglot panda JPEGs.
incidents.confidenceReason: Aqua infers LLM help from verbose, modular, well-commented code; wording is 'likely'.
incidents.summary: Aqua Nautilus analyzed a modular Linux miner delivered via image files. They judged its scripts were likely written with an LLM's help.
incidents.quote: Koske, a sophisticated Linux threat, shows clear signs of AI-assisted development, likely with help from a large language model.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Aqua Security has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

harness.note: AI used as assistant or tool, not as an agent harness

sources.title: AI-Generated Malware in Panda Image Hides Persistent Linux Threat

incidents.title: Okta observes v0 AI tool used to build phishing sites
incidents.outcome: Replicas of sign-in pages of several brands, including an Okta customer; Vercel restricted access to them.
incidents.confidenceReason: Okta Threat Intelligence observed the sites itself and reproduced the technique.
incidents.summary: Threat actors used Vercel's v0 generative AI tool to build replicas of legitimate sign-in pages from text prompts, including one for an Okta customer. The page is dated 1 July 2025.
incidents.quote: Okta has observed this technology being used to build replicas of the legitimate sign-in pages of multiple brands, including an Okta customer.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only Okta has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

sources.title: Okta observes v0 AI tool used to build phishing sites
